stem: Which sentence can BEST follow and support sentence 22?

options.label: A
options.text: He had lived in the neighborhood for 40 years and was liked and respected by everyone.

options.label: B
options.text: The neighbors across the street had moved in just a few months before we did.

options.label: C
options.text: I was excited to learn that everyone planned to help decorate the neighborhood for the holidays.

options.label: D
options.text: There were three kids on my street who were also in the seventh grade.
